title: array2timetable
summary: Convert an array into a timetable.

gpu_support.notes: Inputs are gathered before timetable materialization.

description: `array2timetable(X, timingName, timingValue)` splits a homogeneous two-dimensional array into timetable variables by column. Native integer columns preserve the exact class and values of `X`.
behaviors: Exactly one of `"RowTimes"`, `"SampleRate"`, or `"TimeStep"` is required. Explicit row times must be an M-by-1 datetime or duration vector.

`"StartTime"` applies to `"SampleRate"` and `"TimeStep"`; a calendar-duration step requires a datetime start. `"VariableNames"` and `"DimensionNames"` follow current table naming rules, while `"RowNames"` is not an `array2timetable` option.
All eight integer classes are preserved exactly when supplied as `X` and are accepted as positive scalar sample rates.
Interactive resident GPU arguments are mode-gated RunMat extensions. They gather exact typed storage before timetable construction and reject in MATLAB-compatible mode.

examples.description: Create a timetable at two samples per second
